S: Patient presented for follow-up of dental abscess. Reports mild discomfort in the affected area but no significant pain. No complaints or changes in symptoms since the last visit. 
O: BP 105/91, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6°F, Wt 121 lb. Physical exam reveals stable dental abscess with no signs of infection or inflammation. No lymphadenopathy noted. The remainder of the physical exam is unremarkable.
A: Dental abscess remains stable with no signs of progression or complications. 
P: Continue current treatment with hydrocodone-acetaminophen 5/325 mg as needed for pain. Advised patient to maintain good oral hygiene and follow up in 3-6 months or sooner if symptoms worsen.

A: URI has resolved with no residual symptoms.
P: Continue supportive care. Advised patient to return if symptoms recur or worsen.

S: Patient presented for follow-up of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Reports no new symptoms or flares. Continues to manage condition with current medications.

A: SLE remains stable with no signs of flare or new symptoms.
